#!/bin/sh
# b-studio가 만든 파일입니다. 고쳐도 다음에 터미널을 열 때 다시 쓰입니다.
. '/gateway/codex.env'
interactive=
case "${1-}" in
  -h|--help|-V|--version) ;;
  ''|-*|resume|fork) interactive=1 ;;
esac
set -- '-c' 'features.hooks=true' '-c' 'hooks.SessionStart=[{hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''/usr/local/bin/node'\'' '\''/b-studio-codex-hook.mjs'\'' session-start",timeout=15}]}]' '-c' 'hooks.UserPromptSubmit=[{hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''/usr/local/bin/node'\'' '\''/b-studio-codex-hook.mjs'\'' prompt",timeout=60}]}]' '-c' 'hooks.PreToolUse=[{hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''/usr/local/bin/node'\'' '\''/b-studio-codex-hook.mjs'\'' pre-tool",timeout=1800}]}]' '-c' 'hooks.Stop=[{hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''/usr/local/bin/node'\'' '\''/b-studio-codex-hook.mjs'\'' stop",timeout=3600}]}]' '-c' 'hooks.SessionEnd=[{hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''/usr/local/bin/node'\'' '\''/b-studio-codex-hook.mjs'\'' session-end",timeout=3}]}]' '-c' 'hooks.PermissionRequest=[{hooks=[{type="command",command="'\''/usr/local/bin/node'\'' '\''/b-studio-codex-hook.mjs'\'' notification",timeout=15}]}]' '-c' 'mcp_servers.b-studio={url="http://127.0.0.1:41235/mcp",bearer_token_env_var="B_STUDIO_MCP_TOKEN"}' '-c' 'otel.exporter={otlp-http={endpoint="http://127.0.0.1:41234/v1/logs",protocol="json"}}' '-c' 'otel.log_user_prompt=false' '-c' 'check_for_update_on_startup=false' "$@"
[ -n "$interactive" ] || exec '/opt/bin/codex' "$@"
# 끝난 뒤의 알림을 보내도록 신호에 바로 죽지 않는다(빈 처리기라 자식 CLI는 신호를 평소대로 받는다)
trap ':' INT TERM HUP
printf '{}' | '/usr/local/bin/node' '/b-studio-codex-hook.mjs' session-start >/dev/null 2>&1
'/opt/bin/codex' "$@"
status=$?
printf '{}' | '/usr/local/bin/node' '/b-studio-codex-hook.mjs' session-end >/dev/null 2>&1
exit $status
